_experiment.description: Neuron-level OBD pruning on the reference [196,10,10,10] network. Each step removes the hidden neuron (row of W[l] + column of W[l+1] + bias b[l][i]) with the smallest summed OBD saliency (sum of 0.5*H_ii*w^2 over the neuron's active weights, H = diagonal Hessian of d_W), then adjusts. Shares neuron_sparsification_log.csv schema with e11 (manifold) / e20 (magnitude) / e22 (obs).
